verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the Manifest Gale state — charged shots are drawn with Hurricane Arrow timing whether or not it's active, and the Pressurized Collapse vortex never appears on the timeline.
verdicts.rationale: The skill has effects[] empty and no state/summon window, so the cast shows only a cooldown; meanwhile the normal ability's chargeHits make every 'C' token resolve to Hurricane Arrow frames (parser picks the last chargeHits entry for bows) even when Manifest Gale isn't active — a visible timing divergence — and the vortex that carries the pull and the A1 shred never appears. That silently omits/diverges on decision-relevant timing, so this clears the purpose test. Damage numbers themselves are out of scope and are not mentioned.

verdicts.rationale: Both divergences are visible and decision-relevant. The pulse tail means real buff/shred uptime runs ~4s longer than the bars show, which changes funneling decisions at the window edge. Worse, at C2 the summon carries a durationModifier (polyhedron bar extends to 18s) while the resShred/buff effects stay durationType fixed 12s — the timeline itself shows an 18s polyhedron with buffs ending at 12s, a contradiction a C2 Faruzan player will read as a 6s buff gap that doesn't exist in game. [Adjudicated (Nate implement-first, 2026-07-20): shred+buff split into not-C2 12s / C2 18s condition-gated pairs matching the summon durationModifiers — coverage now tracks the polyhedron at both constellations; caveat unnecessary.]

verdicts.proposedText: Not modeled: the Anemo RES shred applied through the Pressurized Collapse vortex — only the burst's shred appears on the timeline.
verdicts.rationale: This is Faruzan's team-facing signature outside the burst: E → charged shot applies the 30% Anemo RES shred with no burst required, and support rotations are built around it. The timeline shows shred windows only from the burst cast, so any E→CA segment silently loses a real team debuff — squarely decision-relevant (buff/debuff expectations, rotation choices). The charge-time part of A1 is not mentioned because the Hurricane Arrow frames already embed the reduced charge (aimedEFrames), so it isn't an omission.

verdicts.proposedText: The CRIT DMG buff is shown as if it boosts all DMG; in game it only applies to Anemo DMG. Not modeled: the extra Pressurized Collapse triggered by the active character's hits.
verdicts.rationale: The authored effect is a generic team critDmg buff with no element condition, so non-Anemo teammates see a +40% CRIT DMG bar they largely don't benefit from — a rendered divergence from the kit's explicit Anemo-only wording that misleads mixed-team lineups (the guide's who-renders check: the wrong receivers get a visible window). The flagged every-3s Pressurized Collapse proc is also a real omission of kit-visible activity during the burst and is grounded verbatim, so it earns the second sentence; its damage value stays unstated (out of scope).
